intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Herndon for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from December 5 (the Herndon Holiday Tree Lighting and Sing-Along) through December 19, with the Herndon Holiday Model Train Show and Caboose Open House (December 5), the Herndon WinterMarkt on Lynn Street (December 12) and Holiday on the Farm at Frying Pan Farm Park (December 5 to 19) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Herndon, VA 2026
name: Herndon
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Herndon, Virginia for 2026: a tree lighting, the WinterMarkt, a farm light show with Santa and a model train show.
lede: Herndon lights its holiday tree at Town Hall Square, fills Lynn Street with a European style Christmas market and adds a farm park evening with Santa and a train ride.
celebrates: The Town of Herndon opens the season with its Holiday Tree Lighting and Sing-Along at Town Hall Square, which the town calls one of the community's most cherished traditions. A week later the Dulles Regional Chamber of Commerce brings the Herndon WinterMarkt to Lynn Street, a free market modeled on a European Christmas market with food, gifts and a Kinder Corner for children. The Fairfax County Park Authority adds Holiday on the Farm at Frying Pan Farm Park, with a wagon ride through holiday lights, a visit with Santa and a trackless train ride. The Herndon Historical Society rounds out the season with a model train show.
lastyear: The 2025 Herndon WinterMarkt was held on lower Lynn Street in front of the Herndon Municipal Building at 777 Lynn Street, according to the market's FAQ page. The organizers say the first WinterMarkt celebration was attended by more than 7,000 people, which is why they ask visitors to plan how to get there. We did not find a published 2025 recap for the town's tree lighting, so this page leans on the town's own 2026 listing.
facts: Herndon's little red caboose stands on Lynn Street. The Herndon Historical Society says it was built in Ohio in 1949, ran on railroads in the north and was brought to Herndon in 1989, an idea a society member first raised in January 1989. The Herndon Depot nearby survives as a museum. Wikipedia's history of the Washington and Old Dominion Railroad says the depot was built before 1857 and reached its current form around 1881.
trains: Herndon has a real railroad story. The Herndon Depot, a museum today, sits on the old Washington and Old Dominion line, and the caboose on Lynn Street is open for the Herndon Historical Society's Holiday Model Train Show and Caboose Open House on December 5, 2026. Frying Pan Farm Park adds a trackless train ride during Holiday on the Farm. We have no Rally museum guide page for Herndon yet, so the links here go to the hosts themselves.
traditions: The town's free evening at Town Hall Square with holiday music and the lighting of the town's holiday tree.
A free, European style Christmas market on Lynn Street with food, gifts and a Kinder Corner for children.
Frying Pan Farm Park's evening of a lighted wagon ride, Santa, a trackless train and farm animals.
The Herndon Historical Society's show in the Herndon Fortnightly Library lobby, with a caboose open house on Lynn Street.
kidfact: Herndon's red caboose was built in Ohio in 1949 and came to town in 1989, and families can visit it at the model train show on December 5.
faq: The Town of Herndon lights its holiday tree at Town Hall Square with a free sing-along, and the Dulles Regional Chamber of Commerce runs the Herndon WinterMarkt on Lynn Street. Frying Pan Farm Park hosts Holiday on the Farm on five December nights, and the Herndon Historical Society holds a model train show.

Yes. The organizers say there is no entrance fee for the Herndon WinterMarkt on Lynn Street. It is a family focused market with food, drinks, gifts and a Kinder Corner page for children's activities, and it is open rain, snow or shine.
Where can kids meet Santa in Herndon?

Frying Pan Farm Park lists a visit with Santa during Holiday on the Farm on December 5, 11, 12, 18 and 19, 2026, with tickets sold by the Fairfax County Park Authority. Check the park's page for the date you want, since each night has its own page.
Is there a holiday train in Herndon?

Holiday on the Farm at Frying Pan Farm Park lists a ride on the trackless train. The Herndon Historical Society also holds its Holiday Model Train Show on December 5, 2026, in the library lobby, with a caboose open house on Lynn Street.
What is the Herndon Holiday Tree Lighting like?

The Town of Herndon describes the tree lighting and sing-along at Town Hall Square as one of its most cherished traditions, with festive music and holiday cheer. Families sing together and watch the tree light up, and the town gives away tickets to Hamilton to people present.
